a: IaaS provides virtual machines and infrastructure you manage.
PaaS provides a platform to deploy apps without managing servers fully.
SaaS delivers full applications over the internet.
Regions are geographic clusters of data centers.
AZs are isolated locations within a region for resilience.
Object storage holds files/blobs cheaply at scale (e.g. S3-style).
Load balancers distribute traffic across multiple instances.
Autoscaling adds/removes instances based on load.
IAM controls who can do what on cloud resources.
Data transfer out of a cloud often incurs bandwidth fees.
